1.name: JACK OF ALL TRADES
1.desc: YOU GET A FLAT BONUS TA EVERY JOB, NEVER HARD-FAIL A STAT CHECK AN' LEARN A RANDOM SKILL ON LEVEL UP!

2.name: BREWMISTRESS
2.desc: YA POTIONS COME OUT ONE QUALITY TIER HIGHER AN' YOU CAN BREW BATTLE HEXES!

3.name: BENEDICTION
3.desc: WHILE YOU LIVE, DA PARTY HEALS A LIL' AT DA END OF EVERY TURN!

4.name: GUARDIAN'S VOW
4.desc: WHILE YOU LIVE ABOVE 25% HP, YA OTHER PARTY MEMBERS TAKE 15% LESS DAMAGE AN' DA REDIRECTED PORTION IZ DEALT TA YOU!

5.name: GRAPPLE CHAIN
5.desc: CONSECUTIVE BASIC ATTACKS ON DA SAME BAD 'UN BUILD A PIN; AT 3 DA BAD 'UN IZ STUNNED. EVERYTHIN' YOU SUMMON COMES THROUGH WIT +30% HEALTH AN' +20% ATTACK AN' MAGIC!

6.name: CAPITAL
6.desc: MARKETS AN' LOANS FAVOR YOU, SHOPS YOU RUN PRODUCE FASTER, AN' YOU BUY AT A DISCOUNT!

7.name: SANGUINE
7.desc: YOU STEAL 30% OF MELEE DAMAGE AS HP, BUT SUNLIGHT BURNS YOU AN' YOU FEED INSTEAD OF EATIN'!

8.name: DEVOTEE
8.desc: DURIN' NIGHT HOURS YOU DEAL +15% DAMAGE AN' TAKE 10% LESS; YA TRIAL PENALTIES IZ REDUCED. YOU COPY ANY SKILL OUT OF A GRIMOIRE OR A SKILL BOOK WHATEVER YA LEVEL, BUT DA SKILL MASTER TEACHES YOU NOTHIN'!

9.name: TRIAGE
9.desc: HEALIN' AN ALLY BELOW 25% HP ALSO GRANTS DEM AN ADRENALINE ATTACK BOOST!

10.name: ATTUNEMENT
10.desc: AT BATTLE START YOU ATTUNE TA DA WEATHER, GAININ' +25% TA DA MATCHIN' ELEMENT!

11.name: CHI FLOW
11.desc: EVERY 3RD ACTION REFUNDS ITS AP AN' GRANTS A SURGE OF EXTRA ENERGY!

12.name: RUNESMITH
12.desc: YOU CAN IMBUE EQUIPMENT WIT AN EXTRA AFFIX AT NO MATERIAL COST ONCE PER ITEM!

13.name: BLOODRAGE
13.desc: YA ATTACK GROWS AS YA HP DROPS (UP TA +40% AT 10% HP), BUT HEALIN' YOU RECEIVE IZ HALVED!

14.name: FREERUNNER
14.desc: YA AGILITY IZ GREATLY HEIGHTENED (+30%), SO YOU ACT SOONER, AN' YOU SHRUG OFF FALL DAMAGE!

15.name: ASCETIC
15.desc: HUNGER AN' SLEEP DRAIN 30% SLOWER AN' RESTIN' RESTORES MORE ENERGY!

16.name: SPELLSHOT
16.desc: WIT A FIREARM: +25% DAMAGE AN' A LIL' MANA BACK ON EVERY ACTION. SINGLE TARGET SPELLS USE A ROUND; RELOADIN' RESTORES 20% MANA!

17.name: FOOTWORK
17.desc: HIGH EVASION LETS YOU SLIP PUNCHES; EACH DODGE BUILDS A COMBO STACK (MAX 5) DAT ADDS +8% DAMAGE PER STACK TA YA NEXT HIT!

18.name: KAYFABE
18.desc: YOU PLAY TA DA CROWD, OPENIN' EVERY BATTLE WIT A SURGE OF BONUS AP!

19.name: COMBUSTION
19.desc: YA FIRE DEALS +30% DAMAGE AN' YOU IZ IMMUNE TA BURN!

20.name: DEEP FREEZE
20.desc: YA ICE DEALS +30% DAMAGE AN' SLOWS DA BAD 'UNS IT STRIKES!

21.name: AMBUSH
21.desc: YOU HAB A HIGH CRITICAL RATE AN' DEAL +25% DAMAGE TA BAD 'UNS STILL AT FULL HP!

22.name: CONSECRATION
22.desc: SACRED DAMAGE YOU DEAL ALSO HEALS YOU FOR 20% OF DA DAMAGE!

23.name: PACT
23.desc: YOU CAN BURN YA OWN HP AS SPELL FUEL AN' DARK-FACTION STANDIN' STRENGTHENS YA CURSES!

24.name: MARKSMAN
24.desc: YA BOW AN' GUN ATTACKS DEAL +25% DAMAGE AN' NEVER SUFFER DA MELEE-RANGE PENALTY!

25.name: DIVINE FAVOR
25.desc: OVERHEALIN' YOU DELIVER IZ CONVERTED INTO A PROTECTIVE BARRIER RATHER DEN WASTED!

26.name: IAIDO STANCE
26.desc: YA FIRST ACTION EACH BATTLE DEALS DOUBLE DAMAGE AN' NO CAN MISS!

27.name: ARCANE MASTERY
27.desc: ALL YA SPELL MP COSTS IZ REDUCED BY 20%, AN' YOU TAKE TWICE AS MANY SPECIALIZATION POINTS OUT OF EVERY BOOK YOU READ!

28.name: PATHFINDER
28.desc: YOU SPOT DANGER EARLY: BATTLES YOU ENTER IZ FAR MORE LIKELY TA BE A PREEMPTIVE STRIKE, AN' BAD 'UNS RARELY AMBUSH YOU!

29.name: FORESIGHT
29.desc: YOU FORESEE EACH BAD 'UN'S NEXT ACTION, SHOWN ON DA BATTLE HUD!

30.name: CROWD FAVORITE
30.desc: ARENA WIN STREAKS GRANT PERMANENT ATTACK AN' RICHER ARENA LOOT ROLLS!

31.name: GRAVE HARVEST
31.desc: EVERY BAD 'UN DAT DIES LEAVES A SOUL CHARGE DAT FUELS YA SUMMONS!

32.name: FIELD MARSHAL
32.desc: WHILE YOU LIVE, ALL ALLIES GAIN +10% HIT; TROOPS YOU RECRUIT COST LESS AN' DESERT LESS!

33.name: AEGIS WARD
33.desc: WHILE YOU LIVE, DA WHOLE PARTY TAKES LESS PHYSICAL AN' MAGICAL DAMAGE, SCALED BY YA CURRENT HP (A FULL-HP GUARDIAN WARDS 25%). MULTIPLE GUARDIANS STACK, UP TA 50%!

34.name: SPELL EDGE
34.desc: YA BASIC ATTACKS CARRY DA ELEMENT OF DA LAST SPELL YOU CAST!

35.name: SONGWEAVER
35.desc: EACH TURN A ROTATIN' SONG PULSES A BUFF TA DA WHOLE PARTY!

36.name: MIRROR IMAGE
36.desc: YOU START EACH BATTLE WIT DECOY IMAGES DAT ABSORB DA FIRST HITS AIMED AT YOU!

37.name: WAR CASTER
37.desc: YOU CAST FROM DA FRONT LINE WITHOUT PENALTY AN' SPELLS DRAW ON AP WHEN YA MP RUNS DRY!

38.name: CONTRACTOR
38.desc: YOU EARN A GOLD BOUNTY FOR EACH BAD 'UN YOU DEFEAT, COMBAT JOBS PAY YOU MORE, AN' EACH MERCENARY IN DA PARTY CUTS YA ARMY'S WEEKLY UPKEEP BY 5%!

39.name: ENLIGHTENED
39.desc: YOU GAIN BONUS SKILL-TRAININ' PROGRESS AN' READ EXTRA LORE FROM EVERY BOOK!

40.name: THICK HIDE
40.desc: ELEMENTAL WEAKNESSES AGAINST YOU IZ CAPPED AT X1.5 INSTEAD OF X2, AN' COLD NO CAN HARM YOU!

41.name: PHYSICIAN
41.desc: YA LIMB AN' ORGAN INJURIES HEAL FASTER AN' YOU CAN PERFORM FIELD SURGERY!

42.name: METHOD
42.desc: YA CRAFTIN' AN' ALCHEMY YIELD AN EXTRA OUTPUT AN' YOU CAN ANALYZE UNKNOWN ITEMS!

43.name: FIREPROOF
43.desc: YOU IZ IMMUNE TA BURN AN' FIRE DAMAGE AN' CAN PUT OUT ENVIRONMENTAL BLAZES!

44.name: LAW
44.desc: YOU ACCRUE LESS BOUNTY, GET TRIAL LENIENCY, CAN ARREST WEAKENED HUMANOID FOES, AN' SIGN OFF YA OWN CHARGES AS LAWFUL ACTS, UP TA €50 A DAY FOR EVERY LEVEL OF YA RANK!

45.name: GOURMET
45.desc: YA COOKIN' GIVES MORE NUTRITION, GRANTS A WELL-FED BUFF AN' NEVER CAUSES OVEREATIN'!

46.name: PRESS PASS
46.desc: YOU COVER EVERY FIGHT FOR A LIL' GOLD SCOOP PER BAD 'UN DEFEATED, AN' NPCS REVEAL MORE TA YOU!

47.name: BUILDER
47.desc: YA BUILDIN' IZ FREE-FORM, CRAFTIN' COSTS LESS MATERIAL AN' STRUCTURES CAN BE REINFORCED!

48.name: TENURE
48.desc: YOU LEARN FAST: +25% BATTLE EXPERIENCE, AN' READ FULL BESTIARY ENTRIES AT ONCE!

49.name: INSIGHT
49.desc: YA COMPOSURE MAKES YOU IMMUNE TA FEAR, CONFUSION AN' CHARM; YOU ALSO READ BAD 'UN MORALE AN' NPC MINDS!

50.name: EXCAVATOR
50.desc: YA DIGGIN' AN' TREASURE ROLLS IMPROVE AN' ARTIFACTS IZ MORE LIKELY IDENTIFIED!

51.name: BEDSIDE MANNER
51.desc: EVERY POTION AN' HEALIN' ITEM YOU USE RESTORES 30% MORE, AN' YOU DIAGNOSE ANY DISEASE DA PARTY CATCHES DA DAY DEY CATCH IT!

52.name: FORAGER
52.desc: YOU PASSIVELY GATHER WILD FOOD AN' MATERIALS, HARVEST MORE FROM PLANTS AN' SPOILS, AN' SALVAGE TWICE AS MUCH FROM ANYTHIN' YOU TAKE APART ON DA MAP!

53.name: KINEMATICS
53.desc: YA THUNDER AN' PHYSICAL CRITS SPLASH BASED ON BAD 'UN SPEED AN' YA SHIP BURNS LESS FUEL!

54.name: GEARHEAD
54.desc: VEHICLE REPAIRS COST HALF AN' DISMANTLIN' FURNITURE RETURNS FULL MATERIALS. NOTHIN' YOU DO IZ MAGIC: YA MANA NEVER RISES ABOVE DA TEN YOU STARTED WIT!

55.name: MERCHANT
55.desc: YOU BUY CHEAPER AN' SELL DEARER EVERYWHERE, AN' DAILY STOCK RESTOCKS WIT BETTER ITEMS!

56.name: GREEN THUMB
56.desc: YA CROPS GROW 25% FASTER, ANIMALS MATURE AN' PRODUCE FASTER, AN' YA PLANTS AN' ANIMALS YIELD THREE TIMES AS MUCH!

57.name: LUMBERJACK
57.desc: YOU GATHER EXTRA WOOD, FELL TREES FOR TEN TIMES DA MATERIALS, AN' SWING AXES WIT BONUS DAMAGE AN' A CHANCE TA STAGGER LARGE FOES!

58.name: FORECASTER
58.desc: YOU ALWAYS FORESEE CURRENT AN' UPCOMIN' WEATHER AN' ITS EFFECT ON CROPS AN' BEES, AN' WHILE RAIN, A STORM OR SNOW IZ FALLIN' YOU REGENERATE 5% OF YA MP AN' 5 AP EACH TURN!

59.name: SERMON
59.desc: YOU DEAL BONUS SACRED DAMAGE TA CURSED FOES AN' BLESS ALLIES WIT LINGERIN' REGEN!

60.name: SHOWTIME
60.desc: YOU EARN GOLD AN' GOODWILL PERFORMIN', DA PARTY GAINS MORALE AFTER ANY MINIGAME WIN, AN' EVERYBODY'S FUN CLIMBS ON ITS OWN WHILE YOU TRAVEL WIT DEM!

61.name: DIVINE BLOOD
61.desc: YOU IZ IMMUNE TA INSTANT DEATH; ONCE PER BATTLE A LETHAL HIT REVIVES YOU AT 30% HP!

62.name: DESPERATION
62.desc: DA LESS GOLD YOU CARRY, DA HIGHER YA CRITICAL AN' EVASION; YOU FEAR NOTHIN'!

63.name: FERAL
63.desc: YA NATURAL WEAPONS HIT HARD, YOU REGENERATE QUICKLY AN' YOU INTIMIDATE WEAK FOES ON SIGHT!

64.name: SHAPESHIFT
64.desc: YOU STAY DISGUISED SO BAD 'UNS TARGET YOU LAST, AN' YOU COPY A DEFEATED FOE'S SKILL!

65.name: APEX
65.desc: YOU FEED ON DEFEATED BAD 'UNS TA HEAL AN' GROW STRONGER WIT EACH KILL!

66.name: AUGMENTED
66.desc: YOU IZ IMMUNE TA POISON, DISEASE AN' BLEED, RUN ON POWER INSTEAD OF HUNGER, AN' CARRY A REGENERATIN' ENERGY SHIELD!

31.name: PAIN FEEDS
31.desc: DAMAGE YOU TAKE CHARGES YA ENERGY INSTEAD OF ONLY HURTIN' YOU!

41.name: TOTAL RECALL
41.desc: YOU REMEMBER EVERY BAD 'UN YOU HAB FOUGHT, REVEALIN' DEY RESISTANCES ON SIGHT!

43.name: DUAL GRIP
43.desc: YOU HANDLE A WEAPON IN EACH HAND WITHOUT DA OFF-HAND PENALTY!

74.name: FEEL NOTHIN'
74.desc: PAIN NEVER STAGGERS YOU: WOUNDS DO NO REDUCE YA ACCURACY OR SPEED!

99.name: ILL FATE
99.desc: MISFORTUNE FOLLOWS YOU, BUT CURSES CAST AT YOU REBOUND ON DEY CASTER!

152.name: RIPOSTE
152.desc: WHEN A SINGLE BAD 'UN FACES YOU ALONE, YOU ANSWER ITS MISSES WIT A COUNTER!

155.name: BULWARK
155.desc: A RAISED SHIELD ALSO PROTECTS DA ALLY STANDIN' BESIDE YOU!

156.name: FIRST BLOOD
156.desc: YA OPENIN' STRIKE OF A BATTLE ALWAYS CRITICALLY HITS AN UNAWARE FOE!

190.name: MANA WELLSPRIN'
190.desc: YA MAGIC RESERVES REFILL ON DEY OWN BETWEEN BATTLES!

195.name: MOONCHANGE
195.desc: UNDER A FULL MOON YOU SHIFT FORM AN' FIGHT WIT A BEAST'S STRENGTH!

202.name: GUN-FU
202.desc: WHILE WIELDIN' A GUN, PROJECTILE WEAPON OR BOW, EVERY MARTIAL ARTS SKILL YOU USE IZ FOLLOWED BY A FREE NORMAL ATTACK ON DA SAME BAD 'UN!
